bundle.shortDescription: Match participant-level data to neighborhood-scale records, entirely on this computer.
bundle.longDescription: NeighborhoodMatcher links every row of a target CSV to its closest row in a supplemental CSV by standardized Euclidean distance and reports how trustworthy each link is. This desktop app runs the same engine as the website with no Internet access: nothing is downloaded and no data leaves the computer.
